description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order Declare that the Excise Duty Charged, Levied and Collected on Motor Vehicles
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment and application of excise duty regulations under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989. It establishes new regulatory procedures, compliance requirements, and payment rates for specific imported motor vehicles. While it mentions a government minister (Mangala Samaraweera), the core content focuses on legal/regulatory framework changes rather than government personnel or structural changes, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
